title: Men of Affairs
summary: "Men of Affairs" by Roland Pertwee is a novel written in the early 20th century. The story follows Richard Frencham Altar, who finds himself cast into financial ruin after his father's extravagant lifestyle leads to bankruptcy and disgrace. The narrative captures his transition from a life of luxury to the harsh realities of homelessness, as he contemplates his situation with both wit and resignation. Meanwhile, Richard’s chance encounter with a local constable hints at the potential for new adventures, setting the stage for a tale of resilience and self-discovery amidst life's uncertainties.
